hints.title: Two Post Boundary State Split
hints.text: Decompose the state into two cases: the current post has the same color as the previous post, or it has a different color.

hints.title: Consecutive Color Multiplier Rule
hints.text: The number of ways to paint the current post differently is (same plus diff) multiplied by (k minus one). Same requires taking previous diff.

hints.title: Linear Two-State Iteration
hints.text: For n equals one return k. For n equals two, same is k and diff is k * (k - 1). For posts from 3 to n, update same to previous diff, and diff to (same + diff) * (k - 1). Return same + diff.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursively branching over all color combinations takes exponential O(K^N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking two scalar state variables achieves linear runtime in strictly O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should derive the two-variable state recurrence correctly and handle base cases n=1 and n=2.
